title: EC1000到達後の剣斬り・対象消滅
editionScope: First identified independent gallery series for the confirmed no-body disappearance after the peak-EC sword perk. Existing ordinary swing, Iai result, permanent perk/milestone, shared kill cut-in and original gameplay remain preserved.

productionMeaning.function: fighterSlash L11339–11377; EC1000 peak reward L8113–8120.
productionMeaning.meaning: When the owned-sword apex perk has been reached, the guard outcome or the separate noBody:true settlement determines the event variant. Only fighter-energy-destruction-slash with destroyed corresponds to this committed target outcome. Iai destruction leaves a body and is a distinct event. Crossing the EC threshold itself and the source's swing are separate.
productionMeaning.scope: Only a viewer-authorized, current, explicitly same-subject before-projection and confirmed no-body result can animate. Raw server coordinates and identifiers do not imply visibility. Fixture left/right placements are synthetic. A held visible pre-state may remain for denied outcomes; no target is drawn for hidden or empty swing. No cut-in, corpse, fragments, injury, role, amount of damage, reflected attacker outcome, or inference about a hidden subject.

design.primary: A neutral previously visible figure stands over quiet floor seams. One violet contour lights from top to bottom, the figure contracts to a narrow light trace, and the trace vanishes. The floor remains at the same location with no persistent markers or residue. The actor stays absent after completion or explicit stop upon a committed result.
design.timing: 980 ms. Contour crosses from head toward feet to 310 ms; horizontal contraction spans 156–505 ms; figure opacity clears at 579 ms and the optical seam clears by 679 ms. The end of the receipt is observed against the unoccupied floor.
design.reducedMotion: Contracted width remains at 40% instead of 5.5% before the same opacity fall, reducing geometric compression while preserving disappearance.
design.sound: A finite high contour tone gives way to a softer falling spectral component, with silence after 780 ms. Verification mutes audio.
design.technicalReuse: Existing manual WebGPU host for responsive sizing, lifecycle and verify mute. New anonymous fixture, contour/material treatment, projection gate, persistent end state and audio for this outcome.
